verdict.rationale: Coinbase Payments (CDP) is a payments API and SDK platform, not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows CDP acting as an MCP server (`cdp mcp`, Coinbase Wallet MCP, Agentic Wallet MCP tools) that exposes its capabilities to AI assistants. That is the server role and does not make the client axis apply.
